lines: You can ride a gondola in Venice.
Its driver uses a long oar.
You can ride a rickshaw in India.
You can ride a snowmobile in Canada.
ko: 너는 베니스에서 곤돌라를 탈 수 있다.
너는 인도에서 릭샤를 탈 수 있다.
너는 캐나다에서 스노모빌을 탈 수 있다.
body.text: You can ride a gondola in Venice. It is long and flat. Its driver uses a long oar. You can ride a rickshaw in India. It has three wheels. Its driver turns the pedals. You can ride a snowmobile in Canada. It has skis in front. Its engine makes it move.
